To this day, I'm still not sure how I managed to escape. It was just waking up one morning to find the nightmare I was living was finally over; but there's no denying it still haunts me on the darkest nights when I'm feeling alone and I can't reach out to anyone straight away.

I guess if anything the one thing I want to stress is that no matter what, you are always loved. Even if you don't have a good support network right now, even if you can't avoid your stressors, even if it hurts waking up because all you dreamt of was dying; you are still loved.
